facts.fact: In the Lovable FAQ's example table, the prompt 'Make the button gray' costs 0.50 credits.
facts.quote: | “Make the button gray” | Updates the button styles | 0.50 |

facts.fact: In the Lovable FAQ's example table, the prompt 'Remove the footer' costs 0.90 credits.
facts.quote: | “Remove the footer” | Removes the footer component | 0.90 |

facts.fact: In the Lovable FAQ's example table, the prompt 'Add authentication with sign up and login' costs 1.20 credits.
facts.quote: | “Add authentication with sign up and login” | Adds authentication pages and logic, updates routes | 1.20 |

facts.fact: In the Lovable FAQ's example table, the prompt 'Build me a landing page, use images' costs 1.70 credits.
facts.quote: | “Build me a landing page, use images” | Creates a landing page with 3 generated images, theme, and 5 sections | 1.70 |

facts.fact: According to Lovable, in Plan Mode each message costs 1 credit.
According to Lovable, in Default Mode the credits used per message vary based on task complexity.
facts.quote: **Default Mode:** credits vary based on task complexity

facts.fact: According to Lovable, free users can start public projects and have a limited number of AI credits, while paid users can create private projects and have more AI credits.
facts.quote: Free users can start public projects, and have a limited number of AI credits. Paid users can create private projects and have more AI credits.

facts.fact: According to Lovable, Pro and Business subscriptions include credit grants for building and hosting with Cloud, in addition to the credit balance.
facts.quote: In addition to your credit balance, Pro and Business subscriptions include grants for building and hosting with Cloud.

facts.fact: According to Lovable, the value of a credit and the rate at which credits are consumed depend on the subscription plan and feature used, and credits are not necessarily equal in value across plans.
facts.quote: The value of a credit and the rate at which they are consumed for a given action depend on your subscription plan and the feature used, and credits are not necessarily equal in value across different plans.

facts.fact: According to Lovable, most documentation projects can be built in minutes to hours, depending on complexity.
facts.quote: Most projects can be built in minutes to hours, depending on complexity.
